podcast.title: New Uniforms for Each Tour
podcast.body: Hailing from Sweden, The International Noise Conspiracy maintains a unique approach to their stage presence by creating a brand new, distinct uniform for every member of the band before embarking on each tour. This ensures a fresh and cohesive visual identity for every series of performances. "The international noise conspiracy is from Sweden, before they go on tour they create a brand new uniform for everybody in the band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
